ops.text: (v) at Customer's request, Kubient will provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months following the effective date of termination or expiration, at Kubient's then-current rates; and

(vi) within thirty (30) days following termination or expiration, Kubient will return to Customer all Customer data in Kubient's possession or control in a standard machine-readable format, and will thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short exit provision to section 4(c): up to six months' transition assistance at Kubient's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of termination or expiration, and deletion with written certification thereafter. The current 4(c) only stops the Services and addresses Confidential Information, leaving us without our data or migration support; we can accept 90 days' transition assistance if six months is not workable.
proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return in standard machine-readable format, then deletion and certification, into termination section 4(c)
